description: athena-end-to-end-ai-agent is a production-grade software engineering system implemented primarily in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python. featuring local AI/ML acceleration via ONNX Runtime. System Architecture & Component Topology: The core application is partitioned into clear service boundaries. Backend request processing is powered by WebSockets, Express, FastAPI, managing incoming payload validation, CORS policies, and rate-limiting middleware. The user presentation layer is built using React, TailwindCSS, utilizing reactive component hierarchies and state management. The codebase is structured modularly across key functional boundaries including Services (services), Models (renderer/public/models), Src (services/TTS-supertonic/src), Components (renderer/src/components), Lib (services/TTS-supertonic/lib). Data Pipeline & Execution Lifecycle: Incoming requests follow a deterministic lifecycle. The network interface exposes 4 primary REST/WebSocket routes including GET /health, POST /tts, GET /status, POST /stt. Requests enter through designated entrypoint routes, pass through authentication and parameter validation, and execute business logic within isolated service modules. Output data frames and JSON models are serialized cleanly back to callers. Infrastructure, Reliability & Build System: Deployment is containerized and orchestrated through Docker. Environment variables are managed using isolated configuration templates. Automated linting, static analysis, and code quality checks are enforced via TypeScript, ESLint.
